exercises.question: Which sentence uses an impersonal construction?
options: Se cierra la ventana por la noche. [The window is closed at night.]
Yo cierro la ventana por la noche. [I close the window at night.]
Mi madre cierra la ventana por la noche. [My mother closes the window at night.]

exercises.english: The instructions are explained step by step.

sentences: Primero se prepara el material. [First the material is prepared.]
A continuación se activa la máquina. [Next the machine is activated.]
Finalmente se comprueba el resultado. [Finally the result is checked.]

exercises.question: Which sentence has passive-like meaning?
options: Las tiendas se abren a las nueve. [The shops are opened at nine.]
Ana abre las tiendas a las nueve. [Ana opens the shops at nine.]
Ana abrió las tiendas a las nueve. [Ana opened the shops at nine.]

exercises.sentence: El proceso está __ por varios pasos.
exercises.english: The process is made up of several steps.
By means of this machine, the work is reduced.

exercises.question: Which sentence gives a clear process sequence?
options: Primero se prepara el material, después se corta y finalmente se comprueba. [First the material is prepared, then it is cut and finally it is checked.]
Todo el material de esta casa es muy bueno y muy nuevo. [All the material in this house is very good and very new.]
Mi padre explica el funcionamiento de la máquina a mi hermano. [My father explains how the machine works to my brother.]
You have to follow the instructions.
You followed the instructions yesterday.
You do not need instructions.

exercises.sentence: Al final, se comprueba que todo funciona.
options: At the end, it is checked that everything works.
At the beginning, everything is removed.
Nothing is checked.

exercises.sentence: Se introduce el material mediante esta máquina.
exercises.english: The material is inserted by means of this machine.

options: Primero se prepara el material. [First the material is prepared.]
Finalmente se prepara el material. [Finally the material is prepared.]
Primero se preparan el material. [First the material are prepared.]
A continuación, se introduce el material. [Next, the material is inserted.]
Primero, se termina el proceso. [First, the process finishes.]
Después, se introducen el material. [Then, the material are inserted.]
Está compuesto de cinco pasos. [It is made up of five steps.]
Está compuesta de cinco pasos. [It (feminine) is made up of five steps.]
Está compuesto cinco pasos. [It is made up five steps.]

exercises.question: Which answer explains the process in clear steps?
options: Primero se prepara el material, después se introduce en la máquina y por último se comprueba el resultado. [First the material is prepared, then it is inserted into the machine and lastly the result is checked.]
El procedimiento nuevo es muy bueno para reducir el consumo de energía en la casa de mis padres. [The new procedure is very good for reducing energy consumption in my parents' house.]
La máquina funciona muy bien y es muy fácil de usar para todas las personas de la ciudad. [The machine works very well and is very easy to use for everyone in the city.]

template.prompt: Explain a process using sequencing and an impersonal construction.
template.answer: Primero se prepara el material, después se introduce en la máquina y finalmente se comprueba el resultado.

template.prompt: Write a short explanation using a passive-like construction and a connector.
template.answer: El producto se fabrica con materiales buenos y, por último, se comprueba que funciona bien.
